title: The vCenter Lookup service manager webapp must be removed.
check_content:
At the command prompt, run the following command:

# ls -l /var/opt/apache-tomcat/webapps/manager

If the manager folder exists or contains any content, this is a finding.
fixtext:
At the command prompt, run the following command:

# rm -rf /var/opt/apache-tomcat/webapps/manager
VulnDiscussion: Tomcat provides management functionality through either a default manager webapp or through local editing of the configuration files. The manager webapp files must be deleted, and administration must be performed through the local editing of the configuration files.
